source: COHORT-WEEK8.md, read 2026-11-03 9:47 PM ET. Aggregate rates only; no player names.

A1_found_uplift.what: A Squad card on Home doubles the rate players start a group, against the first-share stamp rate (0.054 per entrant-week). Off: founding at the cohort's first-share rate.

A2_friends_pulled.what: A founder pulls in a mean of 1.5 players already in the Field (54.5% of the Week 8 cohort came in as friends). Off: a Squad grows only through new signups.

A3_invite_lift.what: Squad members with an open seat bring a signup at 1.5x the cohort rate (0.04 per active player-week). The multiplier era (W5 to W8) only moved it from 0.040 to 0.044, so this is the weakest assumption. Off: cohort rate.

A4_retention_proxy.what: A Squad member returns like a loser who reloaded: 0.86 after a loss against 0.76 (Reload is the cohort's only measured reason to stay). Winners 0.92 to 0.95. Off: cohort return rates.

A5_nudge_reactivation.what: An absent Squad member comes back at 0.30 a week when squadmates nudge (cohort reactivation 0.18, recent absentees higher; real-player nudges so far: 0). Off: 0.18.
